newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Mpumalanga awards gaming goods licences.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Mpumalanga awards gaming goods licences.

text.p: South Africa's Mpumalanga Gaming Board said on Tuesday it had granted manufacturing, maintenance and supplier licences to Mykohn Gaming Corp, a U.S.-based firm and South Africa's KG Marketing.
Mpumalanga, one of South Africa's nine provinces, is the first region in the country to issue gambling licences following legislation last year legalising casino gaming for the first time.
The board said in a statement that Mykohn was one of the largest U.S. producers of interior and exterior casino signs.
KG intends to enter the South African market as a distributor and operator of limited payout machines and electronic data capturing systems.

The board said it was currently evaluating the applications by several other applicants for manufacturing licences. It was likely to make further announcements in this regard towards the end of the month.
